ON-CALL HANDOFF — gateway 503s (node-3 of 3)

ROOT CAUSE
  dep-4471 set gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true (config gen 119,

  of sharing. The pool is still size 20, so it saturates and requests
  queue until they time out.
  Every 503 carries the same line:
    ERROR pool ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool
    (size 20, in_use 20, waiting 271)
  Corroborating: WARN pool connection churn: 4180 opens in the last 5m,
  baseline is 40 (03:02:30Z).

IMPACT WINDOW
  Starts 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z, 18s after dep-4471 finished.
  Still failing at log end 03:59:27.974Z. Not yet recovered.
  530 of 636 requests failed after onset, about 83%.
  All four upstreams hit evenly: accounts, billing, catalog, orders.
  On-call paged 03:21:05Z at 71% 5m error rate.

ROLL BACK
  dep-4471, gateway, a.novak. Revert config to generation 118.
  Only gateway deploy in the window. Next nearest is dep-4472 at 02:41Z.

NOT RELATED
  Workers are clean. 1080 jobs, zero failures, pool idle throughout.
  Their job time climbs from 327ms to 2197ms, but that starts 01:00Z,
  over an hour before the deploy. Cause is OPS-2210, an unindexed scan
  on SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = ?. Separate ticket.

CAVEAT
  Logs cover 2026-03-14, not last night. Confirm this is the incident
  you mean. Data is node-3 only, so the other two nodes are unverified.
